title: Known Wi-Fi networks
whyItMatters: Every Wi-Fi network the Mac joined, with first and last join times.
source: macforensics.app artifact cheat sheet (Wi-Fi Known Networks)
notes: Root-only (0600); skipped without elevation. Never parsed.

cleanup.exportFirst: Note the password of any network you still need, using Copy Password in the known networks list.
steps: In System Settings > Wi-Fi click Advanced and review the list of known networks.
Remove each network you no longer use with Remove From List.
Remove the matching passwords in Keychain Access; the full reset at the end of this plan clears the system file.
cleanup.risk: The Mac forgets those networks and their passwords; networks you keep still join automatically.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Reset or remove Wi-Fi network settings on Mac: https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/reset-or-remove-wi-fi-network-settings-on-mac-mchl6129bcb2/mac
